**Promotion MR ready: draft PR #271 (reviewer-protocol.md + ADR-0020, Status Draft) — awaiting human signature**

**What**: Prepared the doctrine-promotion MR for Track H H0 (owner asked "generame el MR para la promosion"). Agent-prepared per the Tier-2 / ADR-0013 pattern (agent drafts, human signs); precedent = ADR-0015 / PR #171. Worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-266-promote`, branch `feat/issue-266-h0-promote-reviewer-doctrine` off the tracker 803dfe2, commit `36103b3`, DRAFT PR #271 → base `issue-266` tracker, label `type:docs`.

**Files promoted** (delegated assembly to a sonnet sub-agent):
- `brain/core/methodology/reviewer-protocol.md` (new, 299 lines) — doctrine body copied verbatim from the h0b draft, DRAFT banner stripped, status line = "proposed — pending human signature (see ADR-0020)".
- `brain/project/decisions/adr-0020-reviewer-port-verbs-and-two-key-split.md` (new, 101 lines) — house ADR format, **Status: Draft** (NOT Accepted — agent did not sign). Next free number was 0020 (existing up to 0019).
- `brain/HOME.md` (+2) — co-promoted entries in ### Methodology and ### Architecture decisions.
Verified: brain:nav green (no orphans/broken links), repo:check green.

**Diff size**: +402 counted lines (brain/** counts; openspec/** ignored) — 2 over the 400 budget. Deliberately NOT trimmed (gaming a 2-line overage on load-bearing doctrine is worse than an honest exception) and `size:exception` deliberately NOT applied by the agent (self-absolution avoidance). The human grants it at signing.

**HUMAN KEYSTROKES REMAINING (documented in the PR body)**: (1) sign ADR-0020 (Status Draft→Accepted + sign-off); (2) add labels `decision` (triggers decision-gate: ADR+HOME together, both present) + `size:exception`; (3) mark PR ready + merge into the tracker. brain-writes-reviewed/L6 will flag the brain/** Tier-2 writes — expected, that's what requires human review.

**Why**: decision-gate requires the port-verbs ADR to be a promoted, signed ADR before H0-b can add the verbs; the agent cannot sign its own ADR → hand-off.

**Next after human merges #271**: H0-b code (Phases 6-8) on branch feat/issue-266-h0b-port-verbs-two-key-split. Related: [[sdd/issue-266-h0b/apply-progress]], [[sdd/issue-266-h0a/apply-progress]]. Open item: the reviewer bot handle for governance.reviewActors still undefined.
